channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Hairstory Lands at Ulta Beauty for First Major Retail Partnership
item.description: The detergent-free hair care brand is expanding its reach with a debut in 370 Ulta Beauty stores and Ulta.com, introducing a fragrance-free variant of its hero product.

item.title: Men’s Mass Hair Brand Blvd & Co Debuts at Walmart
item.description: Creative Labs' new mass men's hair brand is targeting a white space in affordable, salon-quality grooming products.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Stars Transform the Burberry Trench Into a Canvas for Self-expression in Anniversary Campaign
item.description: Burberry has tapped a host of celebrities and ambassadors, including Daisy Edgar-Jones, Little Simz and Wu Lei, to wear the trench their way in a campaign shot by Tim Walker marking the brand's 170th anniversary.

item.title: Blizzard Doesn’t Dampen Spirits at New York Trade Shows
item.description: Brand Assembly and Designers & Agents powered through the storm with minimal disruption.

item.title: The Fashion Scholarship Fund to Honor Law Roach, Stefan Larsson and Ciara and Russell Wilson
item.description: The event will take place March 23 at The Glasshouse in New York City.

item.title: Donna Karan Reflects on Her Timeless Designs, Philanthropy and Documentary Ahead of National Arts Club Honor
item.description: The designer will be awarded the Medal of Honor in Fashion from the National Arts Club on Thursday.

item.title: Merrell Aims to Invite More People Outside Through New Brand Platform
item.description: The launch kicks off the outdoor brand's 45th anniversary milestone year.

item.title: Luxury Design Firm L’Objet Sees Buoyant Sales in 2026, Expands Tableware With New Collection
item.description: The Grand Tour collection includes 16 porcelain dinnerware pieces enhanced with 24-karat gold accents, recalling the opulence that enticed travelers to Europe during the 17th, 18th and 19th centuries.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Aerin Lauder Remembers Her Own Wedding as Aerin Launches Wedding Registry, Gifting Platform
item.description: In addition to traditional registry services, Aerin now offers a gifting destination for bridal showers, engagement celebrations, bridesmaids and more.

item.title: Roberto Menichetti Named Tricker’s Creative Director
item.description: Tricker’s flagship on London's Jermyn Street will remain open, and its footwear offering will be integrated into Turnbull & Asser’s retail network.
